title: Project Hearthway shared-setting bootstrap
scope: Only the durable shared-setting identity setting://shared-universe-001, the ongoing-series identity work://series/project-hearthway-main, and their reciprocal shared-world relationship. All fictional setting claims, project-default adoptions, story contracts, titles, and System changes remain outside this decision.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-13, after being shown the exact narrow bootstrap scope and told that all geography, cultures, creatures, history, System ideas, and temporary names would remain proposed, the Author replied: yes.
question: May Project Hearthway receive narrowly provisional authority as the shared setting container for the main ongoing web-novel series without accepting any fictional content?
selection: Provisionally recognize setting://shared-universe-001 as the shared-universe container and work://series/project-hearthway-main as its main ongoing series. Record the reciprocal manifest relationship. Treat Project Hearthway and Project Hearthway Main Series as replaceable editorial titles. Adopt no project-level defaults and accept no fictional or System claim through this decision.
alternatives: Keep the setting DRAFT/PROPOSED and leave the series unlinked, preventing governed shared-world development.
Provisionally approve only the setting identity and reciprocal series relationship while every fictional claim remains proposed; selected.
Accept the complete foundation capture as setting canon; not selected and not reviewed by this decision.
rationale: This establishes the minimum authority and work boundary required for governed development while preserving every substantive creative choice for later review and explicit Author disposition.
evidence: Author selection of an ongoing series on 2026-08-13.
Author approval of the explicitly narrow provisional setting/series bootstrap on 2026-08-13.
consequences: The setting manifest may use workflow status ACCEPTED and canon status PROVISIONAL for this identity-and-boundary scope only.
The proposed AUTHORING series may declare SHARED_WORLD and name setting://shared-universe-001.
The setting and work manifests must point to one another using work://series/project-hearthway-main.
The series adopts this bootstrap decision as its only shared-world reference at creation.
No project-level default guardrail is adopted.
The foundation and Ancestry Development captures remain DRAFT/PROPOSED and unusable as canon.
Changing either temporary editorial title does not change the stable setting or work identity.
residual_unknowns: Final setting and series titles remain open.
The series premise, protagonist, structure, voice, ending, and publication contract remain open.
All detailed geography, history, cultures, institutions, ecology, species, and current events remain proposed.
Whether the series will adopt either project-level modelling default remains open.
Ancestry Development remains a proposed successor-System concept.
reopening_conditions: The Author changes the main work form or requests a different stable work identity.
The shared universe is split into multiple incompatible setting authorities.
A naming or identity collision makes either stable URI misleading or unusable.
Repository validation demonstrates that the reciprocal boundary cannot be represented safely.
The Author explicitly reopens the bootstrap decision.
